text: “I don’t think that,” said his father, whose nature was nobler than his son’s. “Don’t think what?” “That she would have—that it is a case of undue influence. No, to my mind the question is the—the invalid’s condition at the time she wrote.” “My dear father, consult an expert if you like, but I don’t admit it is my mother’s writing.” “Why, you just said it was!” cried Dolly. “Never mind if I did,” he blazed out; “and hold your tongue.” The poor little wife coloured at this, and, drawing her handkerchief from her pocket, shed a few tears. No one noticed her.
